Dialogs.Dialog: Takane
Did you have your first dream of the year？ I dreamed about a golden bunny.
Huh. Sounds lucky.
Hehe. Say, if you could choose it yourself, what would you like to dream of？
Fuji, a hawk, an eggplant！
A dream of ▲高嶺＊＊▲！
Come to think of it, I've never had that one... It'd be nice if we could dream it together, right？ ...Just kidding.
...Geez. Then next year, maybe I'll pop into your dream？
But really, not just in dreams... No, never mind.
Takane
Haah... it's cold, huh？
Yeah！ But you like it about this cold, don't you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Yes. But... when I'm with you, I get cold so easily... maybe？
Then we match！
Time for a human heater？
Really？ Then... can I get a little closer？ And... hold your hand... tight.
Yes, please. I want you to warm me up. ...Just kidding...
Takane
What a nice scent...
This smell is... plum blossoms. Feels like spring is right around the corner.
Yes. I wonder where it's coming from... Hey, let's go look for it sometime？
I'll assemble an expedition！
Found it: the Manaka flower
Y-yeah！ ...Ah, was I a little too loud？ Embarrassing...
Then you're... the sun, I guess. Just kidding... Geez, don't make me say things like that.
Takane
Ah, cherry blossoms falling...
They're pretty. Too bad they scatter, though.
Yes. I want to keep watching them forever.
▲高嶺＊＊▲, eyes on me！
Wish time stood still.
！ Y-yes. Um...... Geez, stop it. Look away？ I said look away.
Hehe, yes. With you, I think I could spend forever. ...No, I want to.
I hope you think so too.
Takane
▲高嶺＊＊▲？ ...Hellooo, ▲高嶺＊＊▲～.
...Ah, sorry！ I've been so sleepy lately... It's not that I'm short on sleep, though...
Sleepy ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s cute！
I'll keep ▲高嶺＊＊▲ up！
Saying it so cheerfully, I won't believe you. ...I won't.
Like calling and texting until late every night？
Staying connected to you like that until I fall asleep... sounds like bliss.
I kind of long for that.
Takane
Ah... look？ So pretty.
Oh, roses. So this is the season for roses.
Right. They're at their best all through May.
They say flowers grow as beautiful as the love you put into them, so the people in that house must care for them a lot.
That's how Manaka bloomed
▲高嶺＊＊▲ wins, though！
Were Papa and Mama the gardeners？ Or... was it you？ Hehe▼
There you go again... If you look at me like that, I'll want to believe you, won't I？ Geez...
Takane
Half the year's over already, huh？ It's July next week...
Yeah. It really flew by.
Right. Looking back... maybe it's been all about you for me.
Same thing at year's end！
I'm dyed ▲高嶺＊＊▲ too！
Yeah. At year's end, and next year too, I'm sure. And beyond that... maybe？ Hehe！
I dyed you！ Just kidding. ...Someday, I want us to be dyed in both our colors, okay？
Takane
Winter break is a long way off, huh？
Hm？ That's unusual, ▲高嶺＊＊▲ saying something like that.
Hehe, it's not that I hate school.
I was just thinking summer break is over. And wondering what we can do over winter break.
Longing makes it sweeter！
I'll start planning now！
......Yes, maybe so？ It's all about balance, I guess？
...Hehe, but what's with the way you said that？ So dramatic... hehehe！
Starting now？ ...Yes, winter break is short, after all.
If we think about it now, I bet we can do lots. Let's plan together？
Takane
When we switched from winter to summer clothes, it seems we forgot to put in mothballs...
So... moths got into something？
Yes, Papa's favorite sweater. Mama knitted it by hand...
Your mom must be crushed
My heart aches for your dad
Yes. But she's all fired up to knit him a new one. Thanks for worrying.
I guess men understand each other.
Someday, if you get a chance to talk with Papa properly, you two might get along, huh？
Takane
Phew. It's a little hot, huh？
Even though it's October.
Maybe putting away all my summer clothes was a mistake.
I kept a few out, actually！
I'll fan you, come here
Really？ Hmm, then I lose this round. ...Just kidding♪
Okaaay▼ ...But if I get too close, I'll heat up instead of cooling down, huh？
Takane
Pop quiz. October is called "Kannazuki," the month without gods.
Oh, a quiz？ All right, bring it！
So which month is "Kamiarizuki," the month with gods？
Can I check my phone？
Also October, since...
Go ahead▼ Looking things up right away when you don't know is important.
...Hehe, impressive. But I won't lose next time, okay？
Takane
I woke up early this morning, so I went to hit against the wall, and...
Whoa, working hard first thing in the morning.
Hehe, yes. And then, the puddles were frozen. No wonder it's cold.
Find frost and crunch it！
Got distracted by that？
Do you think there's any left at this hour？ If there is, let's crunch it♪
...How did you know？ Geez... I hate you. ...That's a lie, though.
Takane
They say bush warblers sing differently depending on the place and their age. Do you think that's true？
I feel like I've heard something like that... or not...
Maybe they have local accents, or older warblers teach them how to sing？
If so, that's cute, huh？
Let's go check everywhere！
▲高嶺＊＊▲'s cuter...
Hehe, right？ Traveling all over Japan together... I hope we can someday▼
That's not what we're talking about...... Geez, let's go？ Come on, hurry. Okay？
Takane
Last night, I saw a news story about a really, really big bunny.
Really big, like how big？
Um... a man was holding it up, and its feet reached about down to his knees？
And it weighed... about half as much as me？
I wanna fluff it up！
I'll hug ▲高嶺＊＊▲ instead！
Hehehe, right？
Hey, let's go to the zoo sometime？ I want to fluff things up at the petting corner▼
Eh！ Um... Right here...？ ...Geez, no！
Takane
Ah, a cat.
Where, where？
Look, over there. Two of them are snuggling up and grooming. It's so cute...
I'll resist petting them
We'll snuggle too！
Yes, they say a horse will kick anyone who gets in the way of love. ...Or a cat kick, maybe？ Hehehe！
Geez, don't try to compete. ...But I agree. Let's get... even closer？
Takane
That doggy we saw earlier...
Yeah, it was so cute！ Those round eyes, wagging its tail like crazy！ It just made me want to squeeze it！
Um... well... right？
I'm not sulking.
But if you don't pay attention to me too, I might sulk a little... just kidding.
...As punishment, give me a squeeze？ You have to do it lots today, or else.
Takane
The other day, the basketball club advisor tried to recruit me.
Huh！ ...You're not going, right？
...Hmm, who knows？
Then I'm going too！
▲高嶺＊＊▲ stays in tennis！
Hehe, transferring together？ Don't worry, I'm not going. Let's keep at it in the tennis club, okay？
...Hey, say it more？ Then maybe I'll think about it... just kidding.
Manaka will never leave your side▼ Hehe！
Takane
Have you ever seen Suzuki-sensei's phone？
His phone？ No, why？
Apparently his wallpaper is a photo of his kid. He takes tons of photos and videos.
He must melt every day！
In his place, I'd surely...
Yes, he must find them unbearably cute. Shall we ask him to show us next time？ Hehe！
You think you'd do that too？
Before that, you could fill it with photos of just me, you know？ Just kidding！
Takane
I heard a rumor the uniform skirts are getting longer... is that true？
Seriously!?
...Hmm？ Disappointed？
Um... not really？
It suits ▲高嶺＊＊▲ now！
Really？ ...Geez, your eyes are darting around. Pervert.
...Hehe！ You've got a "nailed that line！" look on your face.
You're cute, so I'll let it slide▼ Just kidding.
Takane
I have a friend who calls their dad by his first name, with "-chan"... is that normal？
Hmm, I wonder. Seems like it's getting more common.
I see... If I did that at home, I might get disowned.
Try it here, just with me！
Then come to me！ Kidding！
Huh, Su...... No, I can't！ Geez, when you ask, I almost end up doing it.
...You didn't need the "kidding" part. ...Geez.
Takane
Is the way I talk strange？
Hmm, is it？
Someone said it's not very modern... What does modern sound like？
Like "totes cray"？
▲高嶺＊＊▲, stay as you are！
Did I hear that before？ "Totes" means "totally," right？ ...And "cray"？ Hmm...
...Okay, understood▼ But I'm curious...
Hey, teach me just a little next time？ When we study together. Okay？
Takane
Someone in my class sings in a band, and asked me to help out on keyboard...
Huh, what kind of band？
A rock band. But I wonder if someone like me is okay.
Head-banging ▲高嶺＊＊▲...
My girl's not "just" anyone！
Geez, what are you imagining？ I won't be moving around that wildly.
...But, would you like to see me like that？
I see...... But I haven't really listened to rock much. If you have a band you recommend, tell me.
Takane
The other day, I played a difficult piano piece for the first time in ages.
Oh, how was it？
Not good at all. I need to practice properly at home.
I want to hear it too！
Love that about ▲高嶺＊＊▲, too
...No. Because... I'd make a "don't look at me like this" face.
So, once I can play it better. Okay？
"That about me, too"...？ ...I definitely love you more...
Takane
Last night, I watched Cinderella for the first time in ages.
The animated one？ On DVD？
Yes, that one. It really was wonderful.
Maybe I'll rewatch it too
So very ▲高嶺＊＊▲
Then, do you want to watch it together in my room next time？ Hehe, I'm looking forward to it.
Childish... maybe. But I might love it more now than before. Because I met a real prince▼
Takane
I wonder if some fun cleaning gadgets will come out...
▲高嶺＊＊▲, you'd get hooked on that kind of thing.
Geez. ...But, you really think so？
I know. I'm your boyfriend
It's cute, all of it
You seem to know me better than I do？ ...Hehe, that tickles.
That's not an answer... Why do you always say things like that？ Geez...
Takane
I always thought I was a pretty calm sleeper, you know？
Hm？ Did something happen？
Yes. Last night, I fell out of bed. It's been so long since that happened that I was surprised... and laughed.
Head and feet swapped？
I'd have been your bumper！
Hehe, yes, that happened a lot when I was little. Why did I move around so much, I wonder？
Then, next time... Like I could ever ask for that, right？ ...Dummy.
Takane
Hey, I have a question.
Yes, go ahead！
Hehe！ You know？ I was wondering what kind of people most of your friends are.
Curious about my friends？
I won't introduce them！
Yes. Is that bad？ It's about you, after all. A girlfriend wants to know everything. Just kidding.
Geez, that's not what this is about. ...Hey, were you jealous？ So cute▼
Takane
Are blogs fun？
Some people find it interesting. Are you thinking about doing it？
Hmm... I haven't decided yet. Just, a lot of people are doing it, so I wondered.
Post our love diary？
Don't love it more than me！
Huh... is that what people do？ ...Then maybe I won't？ I want to keep it a secret between us. ...Just kidding.
...There's nothing I could be more into than you. Don't worry about silly things. Tsk！ Hehe！
Takane
I see this sometimes...
Hm？ See what？
People who carry two cell phones, what do they use them for？ How would you use them？
Work and personal, split！
Both for ▲高嶺＊＊▲！
Hehe, what's that？ But I guess that's one way to use them. I see...
Meaning... oh, you could text while calling. Hehe, that might be kind of fun.
Takane
What would you think if I learned karate or aikido？
Huh, why that kind of thing？
I saw it on the news last night. It was a junior high girl, but I kind of wanted to try it.
▲高嶺＊＊▲ in a gi...？
I'll protect ▲高嶺＊＊▲！
What did you imagine？ ...Are gis cute, I wonder？
Thank you. But... I want to protect you too. Then it's okay, right？
Takane
Hey. What would you do if we suddenly couldn't see each other anymore？
Couldn't see... ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Right. I had a dream like that last night... it was so sad...
I'd still come see you！
That will never happen
...Geez. When you say it like that, I feel silly for worrying. ...Thank you...
Really？ ...Don't you dare leave me behind and go somewhere, okay？ Promise.
Takane
There are people who are really good at taking photos with their phones, right？
Yeah, yeah！ They look like totally different people.
How do you learn to take photos like that？ I want to know the tricks.
Tilt your head, cutely...
▲高嶺＊＊▲, just be yourself！
...Like this？ And then？ ...Geez, don't just stay quiet, say something？ I'm getting embarrassed...
That's no help at all. ...Don't make me so happy. I'll want to be spoiled...
Takane
Hey. Are you hiding something from me？
Hiding something!? No, no！
Panicking like that is suspicious, hm？ I won't get mad, so be honest？
Secrets spice up love？
Can't say I love ▲高嶺＊＊▲！
Hmm, you have a point？ Just kidding. But don't overdo it, okay？ Otherwise I'll get jealous.
...Why hide it？ Even if you said it every day, I...
Hey, say it once more？ Seriously this time. ...... Come on, hurry▼
Takane
▲主人公＊▲.
Hm？ What？
What？ Did I do something？
Sorry, it's nothing. I just wanted to call your name▼
Yay, you got it▼ You know, I just wanted you to call my name.
Takane
▲主人公＊▲. Have you ever wondered where your name comes from？
Um, let's see...
Never thought about it
I asked my parents once
Really？ Is it because you're a boy...？
Hehe, you too？ I guess everyone goes through that once？
▲高嶺＊＊▲, try calling my name.
Takane
Huh？ Um... ▲主人公＊▲.
Yeah, I'm so happy！
▲Takane＊＊▲！
Hehe, if this is all it takes, as many times as you like. ▲主人公＊▲.
▲主人公＊▲. Geez, what game is this？ Hehe！
